referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This data set accounts for 1 kg of cement, unspecified at the regional storage. 14% are from import, 86% are produced in Switzerland. The imported share is weighted with a factor of 1.1. The imported goods are delievered to Switzerland to 47% from Germany, 41% from Italy 9% from France, 3% from France and 1% from Denmark. 2% are delievered by freight train and 98% by lorry.; Geography: Switzerland
